description.value: Habit Coffee is a community-centred coffee shop in Victoria with two locations, distinguished by over a decade of certified carbon-neutral operations and a commitment to local sourcing. All coffee and supplies are transported between shops by Dutch cargo bike, reflecting a genuine cycling-aligned ethos rare in the cafe world. Beans are ethically sourced and roasted exclusively by local partner BowsxArrows, and the shop works with a wide network of Victoria food and beverage producers.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (23 spaces, covered) at 12m; stands (4 spaces) at 71m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record for the Atrium location at 808 Yates Street with matching phone (250.590.5953). The site confirms active operations across two Victoria locations and features an 'Order' link indicating takeout is available. No explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other amenity details was found in the website text, so those fields default to null; the Dutch cargo bike reference is about internal logistics, not customer facilities.
concerns: OSM record covers only the Atrium location (808 Yates Street). A second location exists at 552 Pandora Avenue (Chinatown) with a different phone number (250.294.1127); that location may warrant a separate OSM/WWC record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established, active Victoria coffee shop with strong cycling-aligned sustainability credentials (cargo bike deliveries, carbon-neutral operations); a natural fit for the WWC directory even without confirmed bike-specific amenities.

wow_evidence: over a decade of certified carbon-neutral operations … all coffee and supplies are transported between shops by Dutch cargo bike
